title: I Got Tired Of Watching The Charts - So I Built A Bot
author: Abby_Muva
selftext:
For context, I'm a full stack developer and I started day trading about a year ago. I got pretty into it, and it actually helped me financially, but there was one thing I kept struggling with — my own impulsivity.

Every trader knows how easy it is to let emotions take over. You take a loss and suddenly you're revenge trading. You make a good profit and start seeing opportunities everywhere, so you keep taking positions when you probably should have stopped. That emotional rollercoaster can really mess with your strategy.

So I decided to combine the two things I've been doing — trading and coding — and built a bot to take some of the human element out of my trading.

It uses information from the charts to identify trends and automatically opens and closes positions based on the strategy I've programmed into it. The idea was basically to have something that follows the rules even when I'm tempted not to.

I've been working on it and refining it, and I'm curious whether other traders would actually find something like this useful.

If you're interested, I'd be happy to explain how it works and what it's capable of.

I'm also considering making it available to other traders for $100, including future updates, but mainly wanted to see if there's actually interest in it first.
